description: This file defines the interface for thread-local storage management in the Trace2 profiling system, including structures, function prototypes for creating, accessing, and managing thread-specific data, and constants related to thread name limits.

methods.name: tr2tls_create_self
methods.description: Creates thread-local storage for the current thread, initializing thread ID and name.

methods.name: tr2tls_get_self
methods.description: Retrieves the thread-local storage pointer for the current thread.

methods.name: tr2tls_is_main_thread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the main thread.

methods.name: tr2tls_unset_self
methods.description: Frees the thread-local storage for the current thread.

methods.name: tr2tls_push_self
methods.description: Begins a new nested region and records its start time.

methods.name: tr2tls_pop_unwind_self
methods.description: Pops and discards any open regions above the first, used during thread exit.

methods.name: tr2tls_region_elasped_self
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time since the innermost region started.

methods.name: tr2tls_absolute_elapsed
methods.description: Calculates absolute elapsed time since process start.

methods.name: tr2tls_locked_increment
methods.description: Atomically increments an integer with locking.
